newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Vietnam Dai Hung partners sell Oct crude in tender.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam Dai Hung partners sell Oct crude in tender.

text.p: The partners of the Dai Hung oil field, offshore Vietnam, have called a tender to sell up to two cargoes of October loading crude, traders said on Monday.
They said the partners wanted bids by 1100 hours Ho Chi Minh City time on Tuesday and the award would be made soon after.
The tender seeks bids for at least 450,000 barrels of Dai Hung crude lifting in the first half of October. A second cargo, with late October lifting dates, might be offered, the sources said.

Australia's Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd has a 43.75 per cent stake in the field. Other partners are Malaysia's Petronas Carigali with 20 percent, Vietnam's PetroVietnam with 15 percent, Total SA and Sumitomo Corp with 10.625 percent each.
The partners issued a tender last month to sell September crude but failed to attract any bids.
